cancelled_job_retention_ms.description: Retention for jobs finalized in this state before the job cleaner deletes them; `-1` keeps them forever.

completed_job_retention_ms.description: Retention for jobs finalized in this state before the job cleaner deletes them; `-1` keeps them forever.

discarded_job_retention_ms.description: Retention for jobs finalized in this state before the job cleaner deletes them; `-1` keeps them forever.

elect_interval_ms.description: Optional tuning: leader election interval. Adapters that cannot configure it reject the request with `unsupported`; the harness sends it only to candidates whose descriptor lists it in `start_options`.

job_cleaner_interval_ms.description: Optional tuning: interval between job cleaner runs. Adapters that cannot configure it may ignore it.

queue_cleaner_interval_ms.description: Optional tuning: interval between queue cleaner runs. Adapters that cannot configure it may ignore it.

reindexer_index_names.description: Indexes the leader reindexes, overriding the default set.

rescue_after_ms.description: Duration a running job may run before the leader's rescuer treats it as abandoned.

rescuer_interval_ms.description: Optional tuning: interval between rescuer runs. Handled like `elect_interval_ms`.

scheduler_interval_ms.description: Optional tuning: interval between scheduler runs and the threshold below which retries and snoozes stay available. Handled like `elect_interval_ms`.
